title: Relay host runtime wiring
responsibility: Constructs the controllers and services used by one durable host object.

inputs.name: hostRuntime.state
inputs.description: Durable Object state passed to the factory to create storage and socket adapters and establish this object’s identity. The ownership predicate compares state.id; the factory does not invoke storage or socket operations.

inputs.name: hostRuntime.env
inputs.description: Relay environment used by the ownership predicate to resolve a host ID through REMOTE_HOSTS.idFromName(hostId) and compare it with this object’s ID. The factory reads no other environment binding.

outputs.name: hostRuntime
outputs.description: The assembled runtime exposes http, frames, and offers, backed by the constructed host controllers, frame service, and pairing-offer service. The factory wires these services without executing a request, frame, or offer operation.
